content.text:
You are the Niyam encoder. Update this rulebook so it matches a new government document.

The validated change set is in `.niyam/changeset.json`. It lists each change with its exact source quote, page and clause.
The source document is registered in `sources/index.yaml` as `gr-202307061137387522` (date 2023-07-05).

Do this:
1. Read CLAUDE.md (the rulebook rules), the change set, and the files of the affected scheme(s): mh.sanjay_gandhi_niradhar.
2. Apply every change in the change set, following CLAUDE.md exactly:
   - parameter change: add a new dated value under `values:` starting 2023-07-05. Never edit or delete older values.
   - condition change: set `valid_until` on the old condition to the day before 2023-07-05, and add a new condition with the same id and `valid_from: 2023-07-05`.
   - condition removed: only set `valid_until` to the day before 2023-07-05.
   - every new value or condition gets `source` / `metadata.reference` with doc `gr-202307061137387522`, page, clause, quote (copied from the change set) and quote_en.
   - if a change needs a new person field, add it to `schema/person.yaml` with a safe default that keeps existing results unchanged.
3. Add test citizens to `tests/` for every change, dated on or after 2023-07-05: just below, at, and just above each limit, plus one case dated before 2023-07-05 proving the old rule still applies. Each case cites `GR 202307061137387522 p.<page> clause <clause>` in `source`.
4. Add an entry at the top of CHANGELOG.md (English, Hindi, Marathi) linking to the document.
5. Run `python -m niyam_rulebook test` and fix problems until it prints `0 failed` with no PROBLEM lines.
6. Do not run git. Do not edit files outside schemes/, parameters/, tests/, sources/, glossary/, schema/ and CHANGELOG.md.

Finish with a short summary of what you changed and the final test result.
I'll start with the change set and the affected scheme's files.

input.command: cat .niyam/changeset.json; echo ---; ls -R schemes/mh parameters tests/mh 2>/dev/null | head -100; echo ---; cat schemes/mh/sanjay_gandhi_niradhar.yaml
input.description: Read change set and scheme file

1	# Changelog
2	
3	Plain-language record of every rule change. Newest first. Each entry is in
4	English, Hindi and Marathi and links to its source.
5	
6	## 1 September 2019: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana (GR dated 20 August 2019)
7	
8	- English: The scheme starts on 1 September 2019 with revised rules. People who have lived in Maharashtra for at least 15 years, are aged 18 to 64, have a family income up to Rs 21,000 a year (Rs 50,000 for disabled people), and get no regular benefit from another government scheme, get Rs 1,000 a month. Widows with one child get Rs 1,100 and widows with two or more children get Rs 1,200.
9	- हिंदी: संजय गांधी निराधार अनुदान योजना 1 सितंबर 2019 से संशोधित नियमों के साथ शुरू होती है। जो व्यक्ति महाराष्ट्र में कम से कम 15 वर्ष से रह रहे हैं, 18 से 64 वर्ष की आयु के हैं, जिनके परिवार की वार्षिक आय 21,000 रुपये तक है (दिव्यांगों के लिए 50,000 रुपये), और किसी अन्य सरकारी योजना से नियमित मासिक लाभ नहीं लेते, उन्हें हर महीने 1,000 रुपये मिलेंगे। एक अपत्य वाली विधवाओं को 1,100 रुपये और दो या अधिक अपत्य वाली विधवाओं को 1,200 रुपये मिलेंगे।
